item.title: SQL*Plus Semicolon vs Slash Usage: A Deep Dive
item.description:
“SQL*Plus Semicolon vs Slash Usage: A Deep Dive”

When working with Oracle’s SQLPlus, the distinction between using a semicolon (;) and a forward slash (/) to execute commands can be a source of confusion, especially when dealing with scripts. This post delves into the fundamental differences and practical applications of these symbols within SQLPlus.

The Core Difference: Statement Termination vs. Execution Trigger

The primary divergence lies in how each symbol interacts with the SQL*Plus environment.
